ot-peyre-cuturi.title: Gabriel Peyré and Marco Cuturi, Computational Optimal Transport (Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning, 2019)
ot-peyre-cuturi.notes: Primary source for discrete transport, duality, Wasserstein metrics, assignment, entropic regularization and maps.

ot-villani.title: Cédric Villani, Optimal Transport: Old and New (Springer, 2009)
ot-villani.notes: Detailed statements and proofs for Kantorovich duality, Wasserstein spaces, displacement interpolation and transport maps.

ot-pot.title: Python Optimal Transport (POT), User Guide and API Documentation
ot-pot.notes: Finite transport and entropic solver definitions, including convention distinctions and numerical stability guidance.

ot-cuturi.title: Marco Cuturi, Sinkhorn Distances: Lightspeed Computation of Optimal Transport (NeurIPS, 2013)
ot-cuturi.notes: Entropic regularization and matrix scaling for optimal transport.

ot-brenier.title: Yann Brenier, Polar Factorization and Monotone Rearrangement of Vector-Valued Functions (1991)
ot-brenier.notes: Convex-gradient map structure associated with quadratic transport; lecture states standard theorem hypotheses.

ot-benamou-brenier.title: Jean-David Benamou and Yann Brenier, A Computational Fluid Mechanics Solution to the Monge-Kantorovich Mass Transfer Problem (Numerische Mathematik, 2000)
ot-benamou-brenier.notes: Dynamic formulation of quadratic optimal transport in terms of kinetic action and mass conservation.
